short_description: Following the hooded stranger to a secluded tavern to learn about the Crimson Depths
weather: cool evening breeze with distant thunder

text_blocks.content: You nod to the hooded figure, signaling your agreement. Quinn's hand remains near their cutlass as you follow the stranger away from the bustling docks. The figure leads you through narrow, winding alleys of Port Crimson Tides, where volcanic stone buildings lean precariously over cobbled streets.
Distant thunder rumbles, echoing through the stone corridors

After several turns, the stranger stops before an unmarked door with a faded anchor symbol. A quick glance around confirms no one is following before they push the door open, revealing a dimly lit tavern room with only a few patrons.
The Rusty Anchor Tavern - Back Room

The room smells of stale ale and damp wood. The stranger gestures to a corner table far from the door, where a single oil lamp casts flickering shadows. Quinn positions themselves with a clear view of both entrances.
Speak quickly, stranger. And show your face. Trust goes both ways on these seas.

The hooded figure hesitates for a moment, then slowly lowers their hood. A woman with sharp features and sea-weathered skin looks back at you. Her eyes hold the haunted look of someone who's seen too much.
My name is Mara. I served as navigator on the Sea Serpent until last month. Captain Vex... he found something in the Crimson Depths. Something that drove him mad.
Mara pulls a folded piece of parchment from her cloak and lays it on the table. It's a partial map, showing strange currents and whirlpools unlike any you've seen charted before.

The Crimson Depths aren't just deep water. They're... alive. The sea there remembers. Vex found an artifact - a coral crown that glows with its own light. When he touched it, the water around the ship began to move against the wind.
A crown that controls the sea itself? If Vex has such power, no ship would be safe. But why would this navigator betray her captain?
Convenient story. Why come to us? Why not take this information to the highest bidder?
Because Vex killed my brother when he tried to warn the crew about the crown's madness. And because... I saw what the crown wants. It whispers to those who hold it. It wants to drown the world.
Mara's hand trembles as she points to a marking on the map - a whirlpool drawn in crimson ink that seems to pulse in the lamplight. Outside, the thunder grows closer.
You have to stop him. But you can't sail directly for the Depths. Vex has the sea's ear now. He'll know you're coming unless you take the hidden route - through the Ghost Currents.
